meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能替你在浏览器里干活:打开网页、点击、填表、截图、提取网页数据、测试网站。页面状态保存在服务端,多个脚本可以接着操作同一个页面。
howto.when: 当你提到“go to [url]”“click on”“fill out the form”等关键词,或提出其他浏览器交互请求时触发。默认新开一个 Chromium,需要登录态时改用 Extension 模式连你现有的 Chrome。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截图看看页面
say.note: 截图存到 tmp/ 目录

say.text: 在 hackernews 页面点击第二篇文章的链接
say.note: 页面名要在脚本里写明

say.text: 帮我抓取这个列表页的数据
say.note: 大数据量走请求拦截回放

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can drive a browser for you: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data and test sites. Page state persists on the server, so scripts can reuse the same page.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "go to [url]", "click on" or "fill out the form", or make other browser requests. Standalone mode opens a fresh Chromium; Extension mode uses your existing Chrome session for logged-in sites.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot
On the hackernews page, click the second article link
Scrape the data from this listing page
